35800.meaning1: praised by Māra; commended by Death

examples.text: ye keci rūpā idha vā huraṃ vā, ye c'antalikkhasmiṃ pabhāsavaṇṇā, sabb'eva te te namucippasatthā, āmisaṃ'va macchānaṃ vadhāya khittā'ti.
sammappadhānā māradheyy'ābhibhūtā, te asitā jātimaraṇabhayassa pāragū, te tusitā jetvā māraṃ savāhiniṃ te anejā, sabbaṃ namucibalaṃ upātivattā te sukhitā'ti.

35802.meaning2: name of an asura; name of māra
35802.commentary: (DNa) vepacitti sucitti ca, pahārādo namucī sahā'ti vepacittiasuro, sucittiasuro cā'ti ete ca asurā namuci ca māro devaputto etehi sah'eva āgato. (SNa) namucī'ti māraṃ ālapati.

examples.text: kālakañcā mahābhismā, asurā dānaveghasā, vepacitti sucitti ca, pahārādo namucī saha.

35805.grammar: ind, excl, nom sg of namas (+dat)

examples.text: namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa
namo te puris'ājañña, namo te puris'uttama, sadevakasmiṃ lokasmiṃ, n'atthi te paṭipuggalo.

35806.commentary: (MNa) namo karohi nāgassā'ti uparivātato apagamma suddhavatthaṃ nivāsetvā nāgassa namakkāraṃ karohi.

examples.text: brāhmaṇo evam'āha, tiṭṭhatu nāgo, mā nāgaṃ ghaṭṭesi, namo karohi nāgassā'ti.

35807.meaning1: homage to you; honour to you

examples.text: yaṃ me kaṅkhitam'aññāsi, vicikicchā maṃ tārayi namo te, muni monapathesu pattipatta, akhila ādiccabandhu sorato'si.
namo te puris'ājañña, namo te puris'uttama, yassa te n'ābhijānāma, yam'pi nissāya jhāyasī'ti.

35808.meaning1: not intending to release; not aiming to ejaculate

35810.grammar: pr 1st sg of na atthi, neg, intrans (+nom)

examples.text: icchām'ahaṃ, bhikkhave, aḍḍhamāsaṃ paṭisalliyituṃ. n'amhi kenaci upasaṅkamitabbo, aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakenā'ti.

saddho vā duggahitenā'ti, yo hi ñāṇavirahitāya saddhāya atisaddho hoti muddhappasanno, so'pi, buddho nāma sabbalok'uttaro, sabbe tassa kes'ādayo bāttiṃsa koṭṭhāsā lok'uttarā'y'evā'ti-ādinā nayena duggahitaṃ gaṇhitvā tathāgataṃ abbhācikkhati.

etha tumhe, kālāmā, mā anussavena, mā param'parāya, mā itikirāya, mā piṭakasampadānena, mā takkahetu, mā nayahetu, mā ākāraparivitakkena, mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā, mā bhabbarūpatāya, mā samaṇo no garū'ti.
ṭhān'āṭhāne na saṇṭhātī'ti kāraṇ'ākāraṇe na saṇṭhāti. tatr'āyaṃ nayo, sassatavādī yuttena kāraṇena pahoti ucchedavādiṃ niggahetuṃ, ucchedavādī tena niggayhamāno, kiṃ pan'āhaṃ ucchedaṃ vadāmī'ti

35813.commentary: (ANa) iminā nayena netī'ti iminā kāraṇena anuneti jānāpeti.

examples.text: ty'āssudaṃ todeyyo brāhmaṇo iminā nayena neti. taṃ kiṃ maññanti, bhonto, paṇḍito rājā eḷeyyo karaṇīy'ādhikaraṇīyesu vacanīy'ādhivacanīyesu alam'atthadasatarehi alam'atthadasataro'ti?
es'eva nayo sutamute. mutan'ti tadārammaṇaviññāṇehi saddhiṃ gandharasaphoṭṭhabb'āyatanaṃ veditabbaṃ.
udakañ'hi nayanti nettikā, usukārā namayanti tejanaṃ, dāruṃ namayanti tacchakā, attānaṃ damayanti paṇḍitā.
ayasā'va malaṃ samuṭṭhitaṃ, tat'uṭṭhāya tam'eva khādati, evaṃ atidhonacārinaṃ, sakakammāni nayanti duggatiṃ.

35818.meaning1: draws a conclusion; passes judgement; infers

examples.text: na tena hoti dhammaṭṭho, yen'atthaṃ sāhasā naye, yo ca atthaṃ anatthañ'ca, ubho niccheyya paṇḍito.
asāhasena dhammena, samena nayatī pare, dhammassa gutto medhāvī, dhammaṭṭho'ti pavuccati.
naye paraṃ yutte'ti assaro byañjano par'akkharaṃ netabbo. lok'aggo.

35820.synonym: akkha, akkhi, cakkhu, dassana, netta, locana

examples.text: akkhīni ca turiyā'r'iva, kinnariyā'r'iva pabbat'antare, tava me nayanāni dakkhiya, bhiyyo kāmaratī pavaḍḍhati.
tayo lokā tilokaṃ, tayo daṇḍā tidaṇḍaṃ, tīṇi nayanāni tinayanaṃ, tayo siṅgā tisiṅgaṃ. catasso disā catuddisaṃ, pañca indriyāni pañc'indriyaṃ.

35826.meaning2: whose weapon is the eye; i.e. King Yamā

examples.text: attavādappaṭisaṃyuttā'ti rūpaṃ attato samanupassatī'ti-ādi-nayappavattena attavādena paṭisaṃyuttā, tā vīsati bhavanti.
nayanti ve mahāvīrā, saddhammena tathāgatā, dhammena nayamānānaṃ, kā usūyā vijānatan'ti.

etha tumhe, kālāmā, mā anussavena, mā param'parāya, mā itikirāya, mā piṭakasampadānena, mā takkahetu, mā nayahetu, mā ākāraparivitakkena, mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā, mā bhabbarūpatāya, mā samaṇo no garū'ti.

so satthu santike pabbajitvā na cirass'eva arahattaṃ patvā jotikatthero nāma ahosi. tassa arahattaṃ pattakkhaṇe'y'eva sabbā'pi sā sampatti antaradhāyi, tam'pi'ssa satulakāyiṃ nāma bhariyaṃ devatā uttarakurum'eva nayiṃsu.

35832.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of na ima, neg

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, ye kho keci atītam'addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā opakkamikā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedayiṃsu, etāvaparamaṃ, na'y'ito bhiyyo.

35833.meaning1: not this; this not; it (is) not

examples.text: na'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ vussati janakuhan'atthaṃ, na janalapan'atthaṃ, na lābhasakkārasilok'ānisaṃs'atthaṃ, na itivādappamokkha-ānisaṃs'atthaṃ, na iti maṃ jano jānātū'ti

35834.meaning1: not here; there isn't; wouldn't be here

examples.text: kiṃ nu satto'ti paccesi, māra diṭṭhigataṃ nu te, suddhasaṅkhārapuñjo'yaṃ, na'y'idha satt'upalabbhati.
na brāhmaṇo aññato suddhim'āha, diṭṭhe sute sīlavate mute vā, puññe ca pāpe ca anūpalitto, attañ'jaho na'y'idha pakubbamāno.

satta vassāni mettaṃ cittaṃ bhāvesiṃ. satta vassāni mettaṃ cittaṃ bhāvetvā satta saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe na'y'imaṃ lokaṃ punāgamāsiṃ. saṃvaṭṭamāne sud'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, loke ābhassar'ūpago homi, vivaṭṭamāne loke suññaṃ brahmavimānaṃ upapajjāmi.

na kho pana so, sāriputta, saṃsāro sulabharūpo yo mayā asaṃsaritapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā, aññatra suddh'āvāsehi devehi. suddh'āvāse c'āhaṃ, sāriputta, deve saṃsareyyaṃ, na'y'imaṃ lokaṃ punarāgaccheyyaṃ.
bhaddakā vat'ime sunāparantakā manussā, subhaddakā vat'ime sunāparantakā manussā, yaṃ me na'y'ime pāṇinā pahāraṃ dentī'ti. evam'ettha, bhagavā, bhavissati, evam'ettha, sugata, bhavissatī'ti.

35841.meaning2: having tied, having bound, having wrapped, having twisted

35842.commentary: (NIDD1) naro'ti satto naro mānavo poso puggalo jīvo jāgu jantu indagu manujo.

examples.text: mātari pitari c'āpi, yo micchā paṭipajjati, tathāgate vā sambuddhe, atha vā tassa sāvake, bahuñ'ca so pasavati, apuññaṃ tādiso naro.
taṃ puttapasusammattaṃ, byāsattamanasaṃ naraṃ, suttaṃ gāmaṃ mah'ogho'va, maccu ādāya gacchati.

sace kho tvaṃ, bhikkhu, brahmuno vacanaṃ upātivattissasi… seyyathā'pi vā pana, bhikkhu, puriso narakappapāte papatanto hatthehi ca pādehi ca pathaviṃ virādheyya, evaṃ sampadam'idaṃ, bhikkhu, tuyhaṃ bhavissati.
maraṇāya vā samādapeyyā'ti satthaṃ vā āhara, visaṃ vā khāda, rajjuyā vā ubbandhitvā kālaṅ'karohi, sobbhe vā narake vā papāte vā papatā'ti.

35844.meaning1: pit of hell; chasm of the underworld
35844.commentary: (JAa) narake'ti jalitaaṅgārapuṇṇe mahāāvāṭe. te kira vajaṃ apavisantiyo gāvo viya nirayapālehi nānāvudhāni gahetvā vijjhiyamānā pothiyamānā yadā taṃ narakaṃ upagacchanti, atha te nirayapālā uddhaṃpāde katvā tattha pātayanti khipanti. evaṃ te pātiyamāne disvā pucchanto evam'āha.

examples.text: pāde gahetvā kissa ime pun'eke, avaṃsirā narake pātayanti, bhayañ'hi maṃ vindati sūta disvā, pucchāmi taṃ mātali devasārathi, ime nu maccā kim'akaṃsu pāpaṃ, ye'me janā avaṃsirā narake pātayanti.
jāyetha no ce narakesu satto, tatth'aggidāh'ādikam'appasayhaṃ, labhetha dukkhaṃ nu kuhiṃ patiṭṭhaṃ, icc'āha dukkhā'ti mun'īdha jātin'ti.

35845.meaning1: precipice of a chasm; edge of a canyon; steep drop into the pit of hell
35845.commentary: (DNa) narakapapātaṃ papatanto'ti mayā gahitāya diṭṭhiyā ahaṃ narakapapātaṃ papatanto. (DNt) narakapapātan'ti narakasaṅkhātaṃ mahāpapātaṃ. papatanti tatthā'ti hi papāto.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, lohicco brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, puriso purisaṃ narakapapātaṃ patantaṃ kesesu gahetvā uddharitvā thale patiṭṭhapeyya, evam'ev'āhaṃ bhotā gotamena narakapapātaṃ papatanto uddharitvā thale patiṭṭhāpito.

35846.meaning1: precipice of a chasm; edge of a canyon; steep drop into the pit of hell

examples.text: sace kho tvaṃ, bhikkhu, brahmuno vacanaṃ upātivattissasi… seyyathā'pi vā pana, bhikkhu, puriso narakappapāte papatanto hatthehi ca pādehi ca pathaviṃ virādheyya, evaṃ sampadam'idaṃ, bhikkhu, tuyhaṃ bhavissati.

35847.meaning1: frequented by crowds and groups of men

examples.text: mah'odadhiṃ aparimitaṃ mahāsaraṃ, bahubheravaṃ ratanagaṇānam'ālayaṃ, najjo yathā naragaṇasaṅghasevitā, puthū savantī upayanti sāgaraṃ.

35850.meaning1: trainer of tameable men; leader of men to be tamed

examples.text: suyuttavādī dvipadānam'uttamo, mahābhisakko naradammasārathi, cittaṃ calaṃ makkaṭasannibhaṃ iti, avītarāgena sudunnivārayaṃ.
na te sukhaṃ pajānanti, ye na passanti nandanaṃ, āvāsaṃ naradevānaṃ, tidasānaṃ yasassinan'ti.

35853.meaning1: trainer of men; leader of men; guide of men
35853.commentary: (THa) codesi narasārathī'ti tadā me ñāṇaparipākaṃ ñatvā n'eva kho tvaṃ arahā'ti-ādinā purisadammasārathi satthā maṃ codesi niggaṇhi.

examples.text: pupph'āsanaṃ paññapetvā, sādhucittaṃ manoramaṃ, narasārathinaṃ aggaṃ, idaṃ vacanam'abraviṃ.

35855.meaning1: (depending on the gender of declension) manly; womanly; neuter

examples.text: kacci kos'ohitaṃ bhoto, vatthaguyhaṃ nar'uttama, nārīsamānasavhayā, kacci jivhā na narassikā.

35859.commentary: (SNPa) naresu ca usabhasadisattā nar'āsabho. (APAa) tattha gavasatajeṭṭhako usabho, gavasahassajeṭṭhako nisabho, gavasatasahassajeṭṭhako āsabho, narānaṃ āsabho nar'āsabho

examples.text: so sabbasatt'uttamo aggapuggalo, nar'āsabho sabbapajānam'uttamo, vattessati cakkam'isi'vhaye vane, nadaṃ'va sīho balavā mig'ābhibhū.
bahū nāvā samānetvā, vaḍḍhakīhi susaṅkhataṃ, nāvāya chadanaṃ katvā, paṭimāniṃ nar'āsabhaṃ.

35860.meaning1: ruler of men; lord of men; king; chief

examples.text: etādisaṃ ce ratanaṃ na icchasi, nāriṃ nar'indehi bahūhi patthitaṃ, diṭṭhigataṃ sīlavataṃ nu jīvitaṃ, bhav'ūpapattiñ'ca vadesi kīdisaṃ.

35861.meaning1: best of men; greatest of being; epithet of the Buddha; epithet of awakened beings
35861.commentary: (SNa) nar'uttamaṃ atthacaraṃ narānan'ti kiñ'c'āpi sabbe khīṇ'āsavā naruttamā c'eva atthacarā ca narānaṃ, thero pana dasabalaṃ sandhāy'evam'āha.

examples.text: kacci kos'ohitaṃ bhoto, vatthaguyhaṃ nar'uttama, nārīsamānasavhayā, kacci jivhā na narassikā.
taṃ ce hi n'āddakkhuṃ tathāvimuttaṃ, (icc'āyasmā mogharājā) devā manussā idha vā huraṃ vā, nar'uttamaṃ atthacaraṃ narānaṃ, ye taṃ namassanti pasaṃsiyā te'ti.
tuyhaṃ kho pana, aggivessana, app'ekaccāni sedaphusitāni nalāṭā muttāni, uttar'āsaṅgaṃ vinibhinditvā bhūmiyaṃ patiṭṭhitāni. mayhaṃ kho pana, aggivessana, n'atthi eta'r'ahi kāyasmiṃ sedo'ti.
caṅkamassa anto vā majjhe vā koṭiyaṃ vā rukkhe sati pamādam'āgamma caṅkamantassa nalāṭaṃ vā sīsaṃ vā paṭihaññatī'ti antorukkhatā dutiyo doso.
atha kho bhagavā jivhaṃ ninnāmetvā ubho'pi kaṇṇasotāni anumasi paṭimasi, ubho'pi nāsikasotāni anumasi paṭimasi, kevalam'pi nalāṭamaṇḍalaṃ jivhāya chādesi.

35867.meaning1: frown; funny facial expression; furrow on the forehead
35867.commentary: (MNa) nalāṭikan'ti valibhaṅgaṃ nalāṭe tisso rājiyo dassento valibhaṅgaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā'ti attho.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte daṇḍapāṇi sakko sīsaṃ okampetvā, jivhaṃ nillāḷetvā, tivisākhaṃ nalāṭikaṃ nalāṭe vuṭṭhāpetvā daṇḍam'olubbha pakkāmi.
muṭṭhīhi'pi yujjhanti, raṅgamajjhe'pi saṅghāṭiṃ pattharitvā naccakiṃ evaṃ vadanti, idha, bhagini, naccassū'ti, nalāṭikam'pi denti, vividham'pi anācāraṃ ācaranti.

35869.meaning1: correct perceiving; non-deluded conception; non-inverted perception

examples.text: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, nasaññāvipallāsā nacittavipallāsā nadiṭṭhivipallāsā. katame cattāro? anicce, bhikkhave, aniccan'ti nasaññāvipallāso nacittavipallāso nadiṭṭhivipallāso.

35870.meaningLit: discourse on they do not exist

35871.meaning1: not a bedroom; not a sleeping chamber

examples.text: nasayanighare sayanigharasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa. nasayanighare vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. nasayanighare nasayanigharasaññī, anāpatti.
nasayanighare sayanigharasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa. nasayanighare vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. nasayanighare nasayanigharasaññī, anāpatti.

35873.meaning1: not loose; not lax; not lethargic

examples.text: ye pana te kulaputtā… sāmaññe apekkhavanto sikkhāya tibbagāravā nabāhulikā nasāthalikā okkamane nikkhittadhurā paviveke pubbaṅ'gamā… tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.
dinnaṃ sukhaphalaṃ hoti, n'ādinnaṃ hoti taṃ tathā, corā haranti rājāno, aggi ḍahati nassati.
tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, kataññuno bhavissāma katavedino, na ca no amhesu appakam'pi kataṃ nassissatī'ti. evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabban'ti.
anāpatti antodas'āhaṃ adhiṭṭheti, vikappeti, vissajjeti, nassati, vinassati, ḍayhati, acchinditvā gaṇhanti, vissāsaṃ gaṇhanti, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

35877.meaning1: is squandered; is wasted; comes to naught
35877.commentary: (SNa) vusitaṃ na nassatī'ti tesaṃ ariyamaggavāso na nassati.

examples.text: samaṇ'īdha araṇā loke, samaṇānaṃ vusitaṃ na nassati, samaṇā icchaṃ parijānanti, samaṇānaṃ bhojissiyaṃ sadā

35879.meaning1: liable to perish; of a nature to decay

examples.text: byādhidhammaṃ mā byādhīyīti … maraṇadhammaṃ mā mīyī'ti… khayadhammaṃ mā khīyī'ti… nassanadhammaṃ mā nassī'ti alabbhanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ.

35881.grammar: pr, from na sarati, neg, trans (+acc)
35881.meaning1: does not remember; does not recollect
35881.commentary: (VINa) nassaratī'ti asāriyamāno nassarati. yadā pana taṃ asukasmiṃ nāma bhante ṭhāne asukasmiṃ nāma kāle'ti sārenti tadā sarati.

examples.text: tīh'ākārehi diṭṭhe vematiko diṭṭhaṃ n'okappeti, diṭṭhaṃ nassarati, diṭṭhaṃ pamuṭṭho hoti

35882.commentary: (NIDD2) m'āhaṃ nassan'ti m'āhaṃ nassa m'āhaṃ vinassaṃ m'āhaṃ panassaṃ. (SNPa) m'āhaṃ nassaṃ momuho antarā'vā'ti m'āhaṃ tuyhaṃ dhammaṃ asacchikatvā antarā'y'eva avidvā hutvā anassiṃ.

examples.text: jiṇṇo'ham'asmi abalo vītavaṇṇo, nettā na suddhā savanaṃ na phāsu, m'āhaṃ nassaṃ momuho antarā'va, ācikkha dhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññaṃ, jātijarāya idha vippahānaṃ.
tassa evaṃ hoti, ucchijjissāmi nāmassu, vinassissāmi nāmassu, nassu nāma bhavissāmī'ti
iti purāṇañ'ca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāma navañ'ca vedanaṃ na uppādessāma yātrā ca no bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsu vihāro cā'ti
pubb'āsave hitvā nave akubbaṃ, na chandagū no'pi nivissavādī, sa vippamutto diṭṭhigatehi dhīro, na lippati loke anattagarahī.
dhitipparaṃ kiṃ mama citta kāhisi, na te alaṃ citta vas'ānuvattako, na jātu bhastaṃ ubhatomukhaṃ chupe, dhi'r'atthu pūraṃ nava sotasandaniṃ.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gaṇḍo anekavassagaṇiko. tass'assu gaṇḍassa nava vaṇamukhāni nava abhedanamukhāni. tato yaṃ kiñci pagghareyya, asuci'y'eva pagghareyya, duggandhaṃ'y'eva pagghareyya, jegucchiyaṃ'y'eva pagghareyya.

35887.meaning1: (vinaya) newcomer; newbie; new monk; monastic of less than five years' standing
35887.commentary: (VINa) thero vā'ti ādīsu vayovuḍḍh'ādīsu yo vā so vā hotu, paripuṇṇadasavassatāya thero vā ūnapañcavassatāya navo vā atirekapañcavassatāya majjhimo vā'ti attho. (SNa) navo'ti aparipuṇṇapañcavasso hi bhikkhu navo nāma hoti, pañcavassato paṭṭhāya majjhimo, dasavassato paṭṭhāya thero.

examples.text: na ca bāhulikā, na sāthalikā okkamane nikkhittadhurā paviveke pubbaṅ'gamā'ti, iminā tatiyena ṭhānena navā bhikkhū pāsaṃsā bhavanti
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. tena kho pana samayena aññataro navo bhikkhu ativelaṃ kulāni upasaṅkamati.

35888.meaning1: novice; newcomer; new monk; monastic of less than five years' standing

examples.text: puṇṇo nāma, āvuso, āyasmā mantāṇiputto amhākaṃ navakānaṃ sataṃ bah'ūpakāro hoti. so amhe iminā ovādena ovadati, upādāya, āvuso ānanda, asmī'ti hoti, no anupādāya.
navakena bhikkhunā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam'assa vacanīyo
ekaṃ ekakaṃ, dve dukā, tīṇi tikā, cattāri catukkā, pañca pañcakā, cha chakkā, satta sattakā, aṭṭha aṭṭhakā, nava navakā, dasa dasakā'ti, satam'pi mayaṃ, bho gotama, gaṇāpema, bhiyyo'pi gaṇāpema.

35890.meaning1: consisting of nine; with nine; ninth

examples.text: cha pācīnato ninnā, cha ninnā ca samuddato, ete dve cha dvādasa honti, vaggo tena pavuccatī'ti, nibbānaninno dvādasakī, catutthakī chaṭṭhā navakī.
theratarena, ānanda, bhikkhunā navakataro bhikkhu nāmena vā gottena vā āvusovādena vā samudācaritabbo. navakatarena bhikkhunā therataro bhikkhu bhante'ti vā āyasmā'ti vā samudācaritabbo.

35892.meaning2: section consisting of sets of nine

35896.meaningLit: canonical text of the book of nines

35897.meaning2: monk with less than five years' seniority

examples.text: anujānāmi, bhikkhave, akataṃ vā vippakataṃ vā navakammaṃ dātuṃ, khuddake vihāre kammaṃ oloketvā chappañcavassikaṃ navakammaṃ dātuṃ, aḍḍhayoge kammaṃ oloketvā sattaṭṭhavassikaṃ navakammaṃ dātuṃ, mahallake vihāre pāsāde vā kammaṃ oloketvā dasadvādasavassikaṃ navakammaṃ dātun'ti.
